primary_claim: Recent frontier LLMs can now perform 2-hop and 3-hop latent (no-CoT) reasoning on natural facts with moderate accuracy, resolving a 2023 prediction that this would remain impossible; Gemini 3 Pro gets 60% of 2-hop and 34% of 3-hop questions right, while all models are at or near chance on 4-hop questions

effect.metric: accuracy on n-hop latent reasoning questions
effect.value: Gemini 3 Pro: 60% (2-hop), 34% (3-hop); Opus 4: 31% (2-hop), 7% (3-hop); GPT-4: 9.7% (2-hop), 3.9% (3-hop); filler tokens boost Gemini 3 Pro from 46% to 60% (2-hop) and 18% to 34% (3-hop)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Prior work (Balesni et al., arXiv:2411.16353) finding LLM 2-hop latent reasoning performance was limited aside from spurious successes; resolves Leo Gao's 2023 Manifold market prediction that LLMs would continue to struggle to compose facts without CoT by 2026, concluding the prediction was wrong
stated_future_work: Discuss more general no-CoT time horizon results in a future post (referenced from related work)
limitations_stated: Dataset has somewhat limited diversity despite efforts to reduce spurious successes/failures

Gemini evaluation uses a hacky prefill-based approach on OpenRouter to suppress reasoning, which may be out-of-distribution and could overestimate no-CoT performance if reasoning isn't fully suppressed (author estimates <10% likely to be a significant issue)
Performance depends substantially on the distribution of facts used, complicating cross-model comparisons
Dataset intentionally not made public / answers removed from released code to reduce contamination risk
quote: I find that recent LLMs can now do 2-hop and 3-hop latent reasoning with moderate accuracy... I find that Gemini 3 Pro gets 60% of 2-hop questions right and 34% of 3-hop questions right.
